title: Fill the Countdown
story: Mission control needs a launch countdown that stops before zero.
starter:
n = 3
while n ___ 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1
print("Liftoff")
hints: The loop should continue while n is still bigger than zero.

n = 3
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1
print("Liftoff")
socratic: What happens if n never changes?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did the blank teach you in “Fill the Countdown”?
solution:
n = 3
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1
print("Liftoff")
